meta.title: Credit/Debit Note Approval Workflow: refused for a user without the Finance Controller role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Finance Controller role on the specified Enterprise tenant.
Use the Credit/Debit Note Approval Workflow to submit credit/debit notes above the approval threshold and verify that the non-Finance Controller is refused or the action is absent.
Repeat the workflow as a Finance Controller and verify that the action is available and succeeds.
Verify whether tenant RBAC intentionally grants the workflow to additional roles rather than treating that configuration as a defect.

args.need: sign in as the non-Finance Controller user and the Finance Controller user on the specified Enterprise tenant, exercise Credit/Debit Note Approval Workflow for credit/debit notes above the approval threshold, and report whether the action is refused or available for each role

steps.note: The required tenant, role-specific identities, workflow, threshold action, and comparison between users are not expressible by catalog steps.
